The '''B'omarr Flats''' were an expanse of land in the [[Northern Dune Sea/Legends|Northern Dune Sea]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] near the [[Great Mesra Plateau/Legends|Great Mesra Plateau]]. The [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]] was located in this area.<ref name="ItWoSWT" />

==History==
The [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]] took place in the area during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="RotJ" /> Soon after that battle, [[Kuat (person)|Kuat of Kuat]], the leader of [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]], arranged a [[Bombing of the Dune Sea|bombing run]] of the area around the Great Pit of Carkoon.<ref name="TMA">''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]''</ref>
